requirements.text: This acquisition is a total small business set-aside under NAICS 488390.
Offerors must be registered and active in SAM.gov at the time of proposal submission.
Offerors must hold a valid Certificate of Inspection for every vessel proposed for this work.
6.1 The contractor shall service 210 fixed and floating aids to navigation in the Fifth Coast Guard District each year.
6.2 The contractor shall respond to a discrepancy report within 72 hours of notification.
6.3 The contractor must maintain a licensed master aboard every vessel performing this work.
6.4 The contractor shall submit a monthly maintenance report listing every aid serviced and its condition.
6.5 The contractor should propose a preventive maintenance interval supported by failure data.
Proposals shall not exceed 20 pages excluding the price schedule and required certifications.
Submit the proposal as a single searchable PDF named CompanyName_HSCG26R00021.pdf.
Proposals must be submitted by email to slc.contracts@uscg.example.gov by 3:00 PM Eastern Time on 30 November 2026.
Offerors shall submit vessel documentation and crew licences with the proposal.
The Government will evaluate the technical approach, the vessel availability and the price for reasonableness.
Past performance servicing aids to navigation within the past three years will be evaluated for relevancy.
